
Copilot in Defender helps security teams proactively hunt for threats in their network by
quickly building appropriate KQL queries.
The Threat Hunting Agent revolutionizes threat hunting by enabling you to investigate threats
using natural language from start to finish. It not only generates KQL queries but also
interprets results, surfaces insights, and guides you through full hunting sessions. These
capabilities empower you to hunt threats faster, more accurately, and with greater confidence.
Read more about Threat Hunting Agent.
Security teams who use advanced hunting to proactively hunt for threats in their network can
now use a query assistant that converts any natural-language question, in the context of threat
hunting, into a ready-to-run KQL query. The query assistant saves security teams time by
generating a KQL query that can then be automatically run or further tweaked according to the
analyst needs. Read more about Query assistant.
